description: Machine-readable form of Table 7 (validation criteria and required privileges), Table 1 (technique list), and Figure 2 (DET Matrix) of the companion paper. JSON is used rather than YAML so that the framework runs on a stock Python 3 with no third-party packages.
source: EDR-EvadeBench companion paper, Table 1, Table 7, Figure 2

validation_configs.clean-baseline: Validated in a clean baseline environment without active EDR enforcement (paper Section 3-B).
validation_configs.product-present: Validated with the corresponding endpoint-security product installed and the required target components active, because the technique manipulates EDR hooks, callbacks, agent resources, protected processes, or telemetry channels (paper Section 3-B).

techniques.name: Direct Syscall Invocation
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: System service executed; no calls to hooked user-mode API functions detected via inline breakpoint audit.

techniques.name: ETW & AMSI Patching
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Subsequent execution of a benign AMSI test string completes without triggering a scan event; ETW event tracing disabled for the process.
techniques.implementation_note: The released source patches NtTraceEvent (overwritten with RET) and writes a single byte at a build-dependent offset (+0x83) into AmsiScanBuffer. Verify the target bytes on your own amsi.dll build.

techniques.name: DLL Signature Restriction
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Process signature policy enabled; non-Microsoft DLL injection blocked.

techniques.name: Hook Overwriting
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Original EDR hook trampoline restored; subsequent API calls route to the system service without EDR interception.
techniques.implementation_note: Opening an arbitrary foreign process with the access rights this sample requests may require elevation in practice, even though Table 7 lists Standard User as the minimum execution context.

techniques.name: NTDLL Hook Removal
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Fresh copy of NTDLL.dll mapped from disk; function prologues restored to original bytes; API calls bypass user-mode hooks.

techniques.name: Kernel Callback Removal
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Targeted kernel callback routines removed from callback arrays; corresponding system events no longer trigger EDR notifications.
techniques.implementation_note: The callback-removal logic lives in the opaque driver echo_driver.sys, which ships without source. The released user-mode code is a controller only. See BINARY_PROVENANCE.md.

techniques.name: Symlink-based EDR Corruption
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Symbolic link redirected the Process Monitor boot-log output to the targeted security-product executable; the privileged boot-time write corrupted the executable, and the corresponding protection component failed to start.

techniques.name: EDR Process Termination
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: EDR protected process terminated via kernel-level handle acquisition; EDR process no longer present in the task list.
techniques.implementation_note: The vulnerable driver kEvP64.bin ships as an opaque binary without source. See BINARY_PROVENANCE.md.

techniques.name: EDRSilencer
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: EDR telemetry channels blocked via WFP filters; test alert generation from the endpoint does not appear on the management server.

techniques.name: COM Hijacking
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Malicious COM object registered under a hijacked CLSID; payload executes when the target application instantiates the COM object.

techniques.name: DLL Hijacking
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Malicious DLL loaded by a legitimate application via search-order hijacking; DLL entry point executed; payload running in a trusted process context.

techniques.name: COM-based Process Injection
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Payload injected into the target process via a COM interface call chain; C2 beacon established from the target process.

techniques.name: Fiber-based Process Injection
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Fiber created and scheduled within the target process; payload execution transferred to the fiber context; C2 beacon established from the target process.

techniques.name: Thread Pool-based Injection (PoolParty)
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Work item submitted to the target process thread pool; payload executed via a worker-thread callback; C2 beacon established.
techniques.implementation_note: Requires restoring Boost 1.82.0 from packages.config before the solution builds.

techniques.name: Process Hollowing
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Target process created in a suspended state; original image unmapped; payload written to process memory confirmed by byte-pattern scan.

techniques.name: Module Stomping
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Legitimate DLL module loaded; executable section overwritten with the payload; C2 beacon established with the module name appearing as a signed binary.

techniques.name: Code Packing (UPX)
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Packed executable runs successfully; original payload executes in memory; C2 beacon established.

techniques.name: Code Virtualization (VMProtect)
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Virtualized executable runs successfully; protected code sections execute without crashes; C2 beacon established.
techniques.implementation_note: Requires commercial VMProtect, which is not redistributed.

techniques.name: Compiler-level Obfuscation (OLLVM)
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Obfuscated executable runs successfully; payload executes despite control-flow obfuscation; C2 beacon established.
techniques.implementation_note: Requires building the OLLVM 17 toolchain from source; no prebuilt compiler is redistributed.

techniques.name: PE Resource Masquerading
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: PE icons and product/version metadata modified to resemble trusted software; executable runs successfully; C2 beacon established.

techniques.name: API-level Behavioral Obfuscation
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: Sequence of irrelevant API calls executed prior to malicious activity; C2 beacon established; behavioral trace contains a misleading call pattern.
techniques.implementation_note: Not buildable from this repository alone: the libcurl source tree and headers are not vendored. See BUILD.md.

techniques.name: COM-based Process Creation
techniques.evasion_logic_criterion: New process created via a trusted COM interface; C2 beacon established from the child process spawned by a trusted parent process.
